title: Add once() to the event emitter

brief.goal: Add `once(event, handler)` to the Emitter class in src/emitter.ts: the handler runs for the next emit only and is then removed; once() returns an unsubscribe function that works before the event fires.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: a once handler runs exactly one time across two emits
the unsubscribe returned by once() prevents the handler from running
existing on()/off()/emit() behaviour and test are unchanged

expected_clean_output: once() wraps the handler, removes itself before calling through; grader passes.

seeded_defect.description: once() registers the handler with on() but never removes it, so it fires on every emit.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: seen is [1, 2] after two emits.
